readout_other: forced swim test; open field test; social interaction test; c-Fos and EdU immunofluorescence; Western blot (Notch1, Jagged1, Hes1, NF-kB, IL-6); H&E and Nissl staining
direction_notes: LIFU improved forced swim and open field behaviour in CSDS mice, increased c-Fos positive cells and EdU+ cells in the right dentate gyrus, and reduced Notch1 pathway proteins, NF-kB and IL-6.
safety_notes: H&E and Nissl staining showed no haemorrhage and preserved neuronal architecture after seven days of LIFU.

timing.protocol_description: Daily 15 min sessions for 7 consecutive days; 1 s sonication, 4 s inter-stimulus interval, 1 MHz, PRF 800 Hz, DC 10 %, tone burst duration 0.125 ms, acoustic pressure 0.134 MPa.

source_quotes.n_subjects: C57BL/6J mice were randomly assigned to three groups: control group (n = 12), CSDS + sham group (n = 9), and CSDS + LIFU group (n = 10).
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: The experimental procedure is shown in Fig. 1A: Mice in the CSDS + LIFU group received daily LIFU stimulation (15 min per session) targeting the right hippocampus at stereotaxic coordinates (Bregma: −2.06 mm, lateral: +1.93 mm) for 7 consecutive days.
